name: Uekusa Hibari
source:
Hibari Uekusa is a rookie nurse who started working at Seisho General Hospital this spring. She becomes one of Keita's attending nurses. Back in their school days, she had a slight crush on Keita but graduated without ever confessing her feelings. Afterward, she attended nursing school and started working at this hospital this spring.

Hibari was a sheltered girl and had never had a boyfriend because she worked hard studying to become a nurse. Her understanding and experience of love are somewhat naive, typical of a virgin.

Hibari's purity makes her susceptible. While she is perplexed by Keita's physical demands, she doesn't find them repulsive.
